subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The song showed that music can carry more than entertainment.”?
options: It is mathematics, labor, and memory arranged so people can cross.
It can carry memory, anger, hope, and collective strength across generations.
A newer tool may be easier, but an old one can connect hands across generations.
It taught her math, manners, memory, and patience all at once.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The song showed that music can carry more than entertainment. It can carry memory, anger, hope, and collective strength across generations.」，答案為「It can carry memory, anger, hope, and collective strength across generations.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It can carry memory, anger, hope, and collective strength across generations.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
